thread:
Mia: Heads-up — we had another support ticket where the SDK returned a bare 429 and customers didn't know whether to back off or contact support. Can we standardize the error payload + console copy?
Jordan: Yeah this keeps coming up. Current HTTP response just has: `HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests` and maybe `Retry-After` header. Not enough context for per-org vs per-key quotas. :thinking:
Samir: Agreed. For infra we need a stable machine-readable `code` and `scope` so routing + auto-retries behave. Proposal: add `code`, `scope` (org|key|cluster), `retry_after_seconds`, and `docs_url` in JSON.
Claire: Docs + SDKs should surface a user-friendly message too (not just dev-only code). i.e. `user_message`: "Rate limit reached — try again in ~1m or request a quota increase in the Console."
Leo: Also recommend headers for low-level clients: `X-RateLimit-Scope`, `X-RateLimit-Code`, `Retry-After` (s). That avoids JSON parsing in some edge cases.
Mia: Example payload we could standardize (SDKs convert to exceptions):
```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "quota.org_exceeded",
    "scope": "org",
    "message": "Organization quota exceeded: tokens/day",
    "user_message": "Your organization has hit its daily token quota. Request more capacity in Console or reduce batch size.",
    "retry_after_seconds": 3600,
    "docs_url": "https://docs.redwood.com/quotas#org-limits"
  }
}
```
Jordan: I like that. For SDKs: raise `Redwood::RateLimitError` (py/ts/rs variants) with attributes `code`, `scope`, `retry_after_seconds`, `docs_url`. Keep HTTP code 429.
Samir: For burst controls we should include `burst_window` and `burst_remaining` when applicable so console can show an ETA for recovery. Might expose `X-RateLimit-Burst-Remaining`.
Claire: UX in Console — show a toast + per-route quota breakdown and a one-click "Request increase" that pre-populates org id, current usage, recommended increase. Link the toast to the docs article.
Leo: Telemetry: tag events with `quota.code` and `quota.scope` and emit a metric `quota_exceeded` with dimensions (org_id, route, model). That helps SRE + product prioritize.
Mia: Rollout plan idea: 1) implement JSON + headers on server, 2) SDKs read new fields and expose exception attributes, 3) update docs and Console copy, 4) feature-flag the new toast and backend fields behind `quota-metadata-v2`, 5) enable for 10% of orgs, monitor errors/CS tickets, then full rollout.
Jordan: One more: add a short reason code namespace for product rules e.g., `quota.org_exceeded`, `quota.key_exceeded`, `quota.burst_spike`. That lets clients implement different backoff policies.
Samir: Ops note — when sending `retry_after_seconds` we must guarantee it's reasonably accurate; if we approximate, mark it as estimate in message.
Claire: I'll draft the docs snippet and example SDK snippets. Can someone add the Console copy PR? Suggested wording for toast: "Quota exceeded: Your organization has reached its daily token limit. Reduce concurrency or request a higher quota. View details."
Leo: I'll add headers + metrics instrumentation. Will also add the `X-RateLimit-Burst-Remaining` header in the next infra change.
Mia: Great. Action items: @Jordan create a server issue for standardized error payload + headers, @Samir add rollout flag, @Claire draft docs and console copy PR, @Leo add metrics/headers. Ops-bot: create ticket?#ops-bot: New ticket created: Q-4123 Standardize rate-limit error format (assigned to Jordan). :+1:
Jordan: I'll own the backend change. Claire send me the exact docs_url when ready.
Samir: We'll set the flag to 10% initially and add an SLO guardrail metric to avoid noisy churn.
Mia: Nice. Small follow-up — should SDKs expose `is_retriable` boolean? I vote yes for convenience.
Claire: docs: recommended retry strategy: exponential backoff with jitter, respect `retry_after_seconds` if present, and special-case `scope=org` to escalate via support link if persistent.
Leo: Sounds good. I'll sync infra PRs with Jordan.
Mia: Thanks everyone — I'll update the tracking card with assignees and deadlines. :heart:
